verdicts.evidence: The intro reads "The new card is used from your next invoice, and nothing already paid is moved", and neither it nor "If a payment fails" says whether a failed invoice is retried on the new card.
"Open Settings, choose Billing, and select Add card" is plain text, and the only link-styled element on the page is the gray breadcrumb.
The steps are prose paragraphs, "Add card" and "Remove" are not marked out from the surrounding text, and "Remove an old card" mentions setting another card as the default without saying how.
